page.layout: One page of text in three-column verb tables, with short marginal notes at the right beside the forms. Running head at top, page number at top right, then the heading and tables in reading order.

main_text.head: VERBVM MEDIVM. INDICATIVVS.
main_text.l: τίθεμαι τίθεσαι τίθεται Pono, uel ponor.
ἐτιθέμην ἐτίθεσο [?] ἐτίθε, ἐτίθετο. Ponebam uebebar.

page.notes: Greek forms are copied from a small, worn print; several letters and breathings in the imperfect and aorist lines are uncertain and marked [?]. Marginal notes are printed in italic type at the right. Faint show-through of text from the facing page is visible in the right margin and was left out.
